messages:
maya (AE): Hey team — customer asked for concrete proof points for availability and backups as part of their vendor review (SIG). They want RTO/RPO numbers, a short description of failover testing, and links to any runbooks or test evidence we can share. Need a one-paragraph answer + any artifacts we can hand to them.

priya (security-eng): Quick note: SIG will expect both our stated commitments and evidence of testing. I can draft language for the questionnaire and attach a sanitized test run log. Are we okay sharing a redacted failover playbook PDF?

alex (solutions): Redacted playbook is fine. Customer is a mid-market finance co — they need low RTO. We should state our typical recovery targets and the mitigations (multi-region, automated routing, incremental backups). Keep it factual, no promises beyond SLA.

morgan (prod): For hosted API: SLA 99.9% (per contract). Operationally we aim for RTO <= 15 minutes for control-plane failover for most incidents, and RPO ~0 for in-flight requests when routed (we replay KV cache + prefix recovery). For large regional outages we have cross-region failover with a longer warmup. I can give a bulleted list: 1) RTO targets, 2) RPO characteristics, 3) backup cadence, 4) failover test cadence.

maya (AE): Perfect. Customer also asked for test evidence — screenshots or a short summary of the last tabletop/drill?

priya (security-eng): I have a sanitized test summary from last quarter (no customer IPs). It shows a simulated region outage and failover executed successfully with verification steps. I can redact node IDs and attach. Also have timestamps of DNS/route cutover and monitoring alerts to show timeline.

ops-bot: Deploy job #40012 completed: uploaded sanitized-failover-summary-2025-07-12.pdf to internal-shared/sales-artifacts (access: sales, security).

alex (solutions): Thanks @priya and ops-bot. Can you draft the one-paragraph answer we can paste into the SIG question and a short FAQ (3 bullets) that sales can send? Keep it non-technical enough for procurement but with precise numbers.

priya (security-eng): Draft below — feel free to edit: "Redwood Inference operates a multi-region, redundant serving platform. For customer-facing hosted deployments we target an RTO of <=15 minutes for control-plane failover and automated request routing; RPO for in-flight requests is effectively 0 for typical customer workloads due to continuous prefix/KV caching and replicated checkpoints. Backups of critical metadata occur every 5 minutes with longer-term snapshots retained per contract. We run quarterly failover drills and maintain sanitized test reports; a redacted summary has been provided for vendor review."

morgan (prod): Minor tweak suggestion — replace "effectively 0" with "near 0 (see FAQ for details)" to be slightly more conservative.

priya (security-eng): Updated: "...RPO for in-flight requests is near 0 (see FAQ for details) ..."

maya (AE): Love it. Alex — can you add the FAQ bullets we discussed? I'll attach the PDF and send to the buyer.

alex (solutions): FAQ bullets: 1) "How do you achieve low RTO/RPO?" — automated routing + cross-region replication + incremental checkpoints and KV cache warmup. 2) "What backups exist?" — config/metadata backups every 5 mins, encrypted S3 snapshots daily, 90-day retention by default (customizable). 3) "Can we test failover with you?" — yes, we support scheduled canary failovers and provide a sanitized test run; timeline and scope agreed pre-POC.

maya (AE): Sending to customer now. Will paste priya's paragraph and include the sanitized PDF link. Will follow up if they request more evidence. :thumbsup:

priya (security-eng): If they push for audit artifacts (logs, full runbook), we'll escalate through security and legal for redaction and NDAs.

morgan (prod): Also flag to Solutions if customer needs Dedicated or Private — RTO/RPO may differ for those deployments and require architecture notes.

maya (AE): Noted. Thanks everyone — will update thread with any follow-ups from buyer.

alex (solutions): Thanks all. :rocket:
